channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: NDP asks Nutrien to consider building at home
item.description: The Saskatchewan opposition leader wants Nutrien to reconsider the location of its export potash terminal.

item.title: Bright side seen as Agriculture Canada cuts research
item.description: Policy wonks say trimming 15 per cent from Agriculture Canada’s budget isn’t a bad thing; they also talk about CUSMA.

item.title: 45Z rules finally published
item.description: U.S. Treasury has finally released proposed regulations for the 45Z tax credit and it contains good news for canola.

item.title: U.S.’s 45Z clean fuel regulations good news for Canada’s canola producers
item.description: U.S. Treasury has finally released proposed regulations for the 45Z tax credit and it contains good news for canola.

item.title: Welcome to the (new) Western Producer
item.description: After months of hard work by the Western Producer’s design, sales, production and editorial departments, we have finally arrived at the first edition of our new layout.

item.title: Beef industry weighs in on research cuts
item.description: The Canadian Cattle Association and Beef Cattle Research Council said cuts to federal research centres and programs will have long-term debilitating consequences for the beef industry.

item.title: Loss of agriculture research capacity lamented
item.description: A U of S agricultural economist said the decision to find savings at the very basis of farm production will have far-reaching effects and represents significant losses to the sector.

item.title: Traceability, Canadian Food Inspection Agency dominate Saskatchewan cattle meeting
item.description: Nine of the 18 resolutions presented during the Saskatchewan Cattle Association’s recent annual general meeting were about he Canada Food Inspection Agency and its proposed traceability regulations.

item.title: Canola industry pumped about 45Z ruling in U.S.
item.description: Canada’s canola sector is pleased with the new 45Z guidance published by U.S. Treasury.
